title: Say 'voice credits used up' instead of 'key rejected', and make health tell the truth
requested_outcome: On 2026-09-25 the production voice was down and CLIVE said 'the ElevenLabs key was rejected', while /health reported voice ok. The real cause, found from the journal: ElevenLabs answered 401 with body detail code quota_exceeded ('You have 0 credits remaining'), for both text-to-speech (Derek) and Scribe transcription, since 2026-09-22. Two defects made an empty account look like a bad key. (1) In app/clients/elevenlabs_tts.py _http_failure checks 'code in (401, 403)' before the quota and credit test, so a 401 quota_exceeded is classed 'rejected' instead of 'credit'; app/clients/elevenlabs.py (Scribe) must be checked for the same ordering. Classify a quota or credit body as 'credit' whatever the status code, keeping 'rejected' for a genuinely invalid key. (2) The owner-facing reason in app/routes/speak.py (and wherever a transcription failure is worded) must say in plain words what happened and what to do, for example that voice is paused because the ElevenLabs credits are used up and comes back by itself once the plan is topped up; no runtime-host wording. (3) /health must not report voice ok while the latest attempt failed with no success since: report ok false with the kind and the plain reason, and ok again after the next success; do the same for transcription if /health reports it. Tests with faked ElevenLabs responses: 401 quota_exceeded is 'credit' for both clients, 401 invalid key stays 'rejected', the spoken and health wording for credit, and health recovering after a success. This objective continues from its own earlier candidate, the base commit 83dc408702 (branch clive/objective/voice-credits-honest). Three rounds of independent review left one open finding (F-01) when the repair budget ran out; the review of your change will state it. acceptance_criteria: a 401 or 402 or 429 whose body reports quota or credits is classed 'credit' in both ElevenLabs clients; an invalid key is still 'rejected'
the owner hears and sees that voice is paused because credits are used up and what brings it back, in plain words
/health reports voice not ok with the kind and reason while the latest attempt failed, and ok again after a success
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
